data.title: Changing a mobile plan
data.excerpt: Fictional DemoTel policy: Request a plan change in the app under My Plan or contact support. A change takes effect at the next billing cycle. Existing contractual commitments must be checked by support. No retention discount is guaranteed. The assistant can explain options but cannot modify a subscription.
